name: OpenAlex AI Agent Connector
description: Lets AI assistants search and analyze OpenAlex scholarly works, authors, institutions, and citations over a remote MCP server with OAuth, returning the exact OQL query behind each answer.

skills.name: Search Works
skills.description: Finds papers by keyword, semantic meaning, or raw OQL with filters for year, open access, citations, and author, institution, or funder IDs.

skills.name: Resolve References
skills.description: Checks up to 25 citations, DOIs, or free-text references per call, reporting whether each exists and filling in missing DOIs.

skills.name: Citation Graph
skills.description: Lists the works that cite a paper, the works it references, or related works, so agents can trace follow-up research on a topic.

skills.name: Analyze Works
skills.description: Profiles any set of works with totals, open-access share, top-cited share, yearly trends, and top fields, institutions, and countries.
